release_notes:
Fix post-hoc SSL instructions: certbot was never installed when SSL skipped

Hit this live on the bestpriceunlock.com install: DNS wasn't ready at
install time, so install.sh correctly skipped the whole SSL step — but
every "run this once DNS is ready" hint (in-script warnings and the
credentials file) just said to run certbot directly, which was never
installed. Added the apt-get install line everywhere that hint appears.

Also added ServerAlias www.$DOMAIN to the generated VirtualHost — without
it, requesting a cert for the www subdomain later fails with "vhost
ambiguity" since certbot can't tell which vhost it belongs to.
